decisions.reason: The organic salami platter has stayed on the website for two years without any promotion, a sign of modest but steady performance, and keeping it costs little, so the option stays open.
The premium sharing snack was expanded with Classic and Poultry variants in 2024, so management is committing further to this line rather than abandoning it.

The organic boiled pork sausage launched in 2024 and is actively promoted on its own page, its prospects are still uncertain, and organic Fleischwurst is an established category, so dropping it now would be premature.
The thinly sliced organic chicken breast is a recent launch with two flavours and its own page, and too little is known yet to justify abandoning it.
The herb-coated organic salami is new, has its own page and fits the firm's core salami range, so keeping the option costs little while uncertainty resolves.
